annotations.title: Find music artists on SoundCloud and Spotify

description: Music artists from SoundCloud and Spotify by search words, artist links or playlist links: verified, independent or signed (from release label lines), followers, monthly listeners, top cities, latest releases, upcoming concerts, bio, website, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube links, public emails, and a lead score; optionally similar artists and their latest tracks with plays and likes. No login. Useful for A&R scouting, booking, music marketing and creator outreach. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/media-profiles on your Apify account (about $0.0025 per artist, $0.001 per track; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

links.description: Artist, track or playlist links on SoundCloud or Spotify.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

queries.description: Search words, e.g. ["lofi hip hop", "indie folk berlin"].

similar_artists.description: Similar artists to add per artist found.

tracks_per_artist.description: Latest tracks to add per artist (0 = profiles only).

name: find_music_artists

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Find music artists on SoundCloud and Spotify
